DC20AP.Label: Action Points
DC20AP.MaxHint: Max AP for this combatant (leave empty to use the default)
DC20AP.Duplicate: Add another initiative for this combatant (shares HP and AP)
DC20AP.Linked: Linked: shares HP and AP with the original combatant

Notifications.NotEnough: {name}: {action} costs {cost} AP, but only {remaining} AP are left.

DefaultMax.Name: Default Max AP
DefaultMax.Hint: Max Action Points for combatants without an individual value.

AutoConsume.Name: Consume AP automatically
AutoConsume.Hint: Spend AP automatically when a combatant uses an action or bonus action (D&D 5e), or moves during its own turn.

ActionCost.Name: AP cost: Action
ActionCost.Hint: AP spent when an activity with activation type Action is used.

BonusActionCost.Name: AP cost: Bonus Action
BonusActionCost.Hint: AP spent when an activity with activation type Bonus Action is used.

MoveCost.Name: AP cost: Movement
MoveCost.Hint: AP spent as soon as a combatant starts moving during its own turn (once per turn).

OverSpeedCost.Name: AP cost: Moving beyond speed
OverSpeedCost.Hint: Additional AP spent once per turn when the total movement in a combatant's turn exceeds its speed.
